question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank

Tagore and Gandhi were undoubtedly the two outstanding and _________ figures of India in the first half of twentieth century.
solution:
The correct answer is **Dominating**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given options the correct option to be filled in the blank is **Dominating.**
 
• **Dominating:** Someone who is more potent, significant, or prominent than others.
 
 
• **Example:** Chess has always been a dominating aspect of my life.&
